notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Ornithopter enters the battlefield, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.
